title: The Biased Samaritan: LLM biases in Perceived Kindness
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It measures demographic biases in Large Language Models related to gender, race, and age by prompting models to quantitatively assess a moral patient's willingness to help in various scenarios.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the study.
